title: Healthcare Wait Time Distribution
scenario: Find the 90th percentile wait time for each clinic.
hint: Use PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY minutes).
correctQuery: SELECT clinic_id, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY minutes) OVER(PARTITION BY clinic_id) as p90_wait FROM wait_times;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE wait_times (clinic_id INT, minutes INT);
